rationale: The 135 bps bid-ask spread creates an immediate cost headwind that materially reduces the risk/reward on any entry. Price has already recovered from $10.20 to $11.11 (79% of today's range) and is pressing near today's high of $11.35, leaving little room for a long entry before natural resistance, while no identifiable catalyst exists to explain the 21% gap or support a directional thesis. With the spread cost, uncertain fundamental driver, and price already extended above the 5-min VWAP, there is insufficient edge to justify a position in either direction.
